title: Emission Tracking Agent

approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: There's an agent to guide energy operators through these processes. It reads the systems you already work in, engages you directly in Microsoft Teams.
script.vo02: Let's say a manager needs to monitor GHG emissions. Before, they would have needed to jump across multiple systems to manually gather insights, piecing the picture together by hand, and hoping nothing moved while they worked.
script.vo03: It reads the systems of record already in use, engages you in Microsoft Teams and Outlook, and monitors emissions and carbon offset opportunities, showing its reasoning.
script.vo04: But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand.
script.vo05: Now, with one unified data context, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary.
script.vo06: It can analyze carbon offset opportunities in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on.
script.vo_payoff: With Emission Tracking Agent, energy operators get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.
script.vo_helps: The result? Work that moves faster, stays consistent, and holds the same standard every time it runs.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
